mapper.sql: instrument_id, instrument_type, exchange, code, name, board, currency, timezone, listed_at, delisted_at, status
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO instrument (instrument_id, instrument_type, exchange, code, name, board, currency, timezone, listed_at, delisted_at, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{it.instrumentId}, #{it.instrumentType}, #{it.exchange}, #{it.code}, #{it.name}, #{it.board}, #{it.currency}, #{it.timezone}, #{it.listedAt}, #{it.delistedAt}, #{it.status}, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
ON CONFLICT (instrument_id) DO UPDATE SET
name = excluded.name, board = excluded.board, status = excluded.status, listed_at = COALESCE(instrument.listed_at, excluded.listed_at), delisted_at = excluded.delisted_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM instrument WHERE status <> 'DELISTED' ORDER BY instrument_id

SELECT i.instrument_id, i.instrument_type, i.exchange, i.code, i.name, i.board, i.currency, i.timezone, i.listed_at, i.delisted_at, i.status FROM instrument i WHERE i.status <> 'DELISTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_bar b WHERE b.instrument_id = i.instrument_id) ORDER BY i.instrument_id
SELECT FROM instrument WHERE instrument_type = #{instrumentType} AND status <> 'DELISTED' ORDER BY instrument_id
mapper.update: UPDATE instrument SET listed_at = #{listedAt}, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime') WHERE instrument_id = #{instrumentId} AND listed_at IS NULL
